verdict.rationale: Shopify claims that "Shoppers check out right in the chat," and its Checkout MCP documents complete_checkout to submit payment and place the order. However, only Token-tier agents granted purchase permission can use it; the default and escalation paths hand the buyer off via continue_url to the merchant's own storefront checkout. A runtime probe created a live cart but stopped before checkout or payment, and no evidence shows live in-chat checkout on the named surfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot). Missing for 10: evidence of shipping integrations with the named assistant surfaces, in-chat completion for non-Token-tier agents without handoff, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a completed in-chat purchase.
